name: dogfood-otel-exemplar-app
description: Dogfood app v1.35-3 — an OpenTelemetry Collector + exemplar tracing (trace-to-metric / metric-to-trace) + baggage propagation + W3C context propagation harness driven behind a provider-neutral surface backed by @kiwa-lab/observability v2.1 semantics (exemplar + otel-advanced axes) + real-driver env-gate. Two adapter implementations satisfy the same 16-op contract: makeMockAdapter walks the observability v2.1 exemplar + otel-advanced state machines deterministically without any backend; makeRealAdapter emits OTLP HTTP export + Collector pipeline requests through the KIWA_MODE=real testcontainers-driven OpenTelemetry Collector + Jaeger + Prometheus stack when KIWA_OTEL_COLLECTOR_URL / KIWA_JAEGER_URL / KIWA_PROMETHEUS_URL are wired, and otherwise reports KIWA_OTEL_ENV_MISSING so callers can budget the fallback. The fidelity harness diffs both traces side-by-side across 3 pipeline profiles (traces / metrics / logs) × 4 baggage entry sets so behavioural drift between mock semantics and the real OpenTelemetry Collector stays observable and feeds the @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 13-axis release gate.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/observability @kiwa-lab/core @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
